==============
Sloplint: hash command
==============

#lint
#find _ + _ = _ + _
#whnf Nat.add 1 2

---

(module
  (hash_cmd
    command: (hash_name))
  (hash_cmd
    command: (hash_name)
    arg: (binary_op
      lhs: (binary_op
        lhs: (hole)
        rhs: (hole))
      rhs: (binary_op
        lhs: (hole)
        rhs: (hole))))
  (hash_cmd
    command: (hash_name)
    arg: (app
      fn: (app
        fn: (identifier)
        arg: (num_lit))
      arg: (num_lit))))

==============
Sloplint: hash command with in-body
==============

#guard_msgs in
#eval "hi"

---

(module
  (hash_cmd
    command: (hash_name)
    body: (eval
      term: (str_lit))))

      arg: (str_lit))))

==============
Sloplint: try-catch-finally in do blocks
==============

def t1 : IO Unit := do
  try
    let x ← pure 1
    IO.println x
  catch e =>
    IO.println e
  finally
    IO.println "done"

def t2 : IO Unit := do
  try
    risky
  catch
    | e1 => pure ()
    | e2 => pure ()

---

(module
  (declaration
    (def
      name: (identifier)
      type: (app
        fn: (identifier)
        arg: (identifier))
      body: (do_block
        stmt: (do_try
          stmt: (let
            name: (identifier)
            value: (app
              fn: (identifier)
              arg: (num_lit)))
          stmt: (app
            fn: (identifier)
            arg: (identifier))
          name: (identifier)
          body: (app
            fn: (identifier)
            arg: (identifier))
          stmt: (app
            fn: (identifier)
            arg: (str_lit))))))
  (declaration
    (def
      name: (identifier)
      type: (app
        fn: (identifier)
        arg: (identifier))
      body: (do_block
        stmt: (do_try
          stmt: (identifier)
          pattern: (identifier)
          body: (app
            fn: (identifier)
            arg: (paren))
          pattern: (identifier)
          body: (app
            fn: (identifier)
            arg: (paren)))))))

            arg: (identifier)))))))

  try
    risky
  pure ()

          name: (identifier)
          value: (do_block
            stmt: (app
              fn: (identifier)
              arg: (num_lit))))
        stmt: (app
          fn: (identifier)
          arg: (identifier)))))
  (declaration
    (def
      name: (identifier)
      type: (app
        fn: (identifier)
        arg: (identifier))
      body: (do_block

          stmt: (identifier))

          fn: (identifier)
          arg: (paren))))))

      name: (identifier)
      type: (type_const
        (identifier)))
    (instance_binder
      type: (app
        fn: (universe_app
          term: (identifier)
          level: (identifier))
        arg: (identifier)))))

        target: (identifier)))))

          arg: (identifier))))))

==============
Sloplint: dedent past for and try blocks to next declaration
==============

def a : IO Unit := do
  for x in xs do
    y
  try
    x
  finally
    y
def b : Nat := 0

---

(module
  (declaration
    (def
      name: (identifier)
      type: (app
        fn: (identifier)
        arg: (identifier))
      body: (do_block
        stmt: (for_loop
          name: (identifier)
          range: (identifier)
          stmt: (identifier))
        stmt: (do_try
          stmt: (identifier)
          stmt: (identifier)))))
  (declaration
    (def
      name: (identifier)
      type: (identifier)
      body: (num_lit))))
